_comment: Whatever shines, shining as hard as it can. `glow` is one name on the stars, the curtain and the bow, so
this is the same word about all three and about anything that grows a glow later; on land, biomes and
what grows it leans towards what is pale, well lit or gives off light of its own.
It absorbed `glimmering`, which set the same glow (retired.json).
